# polytomic_adroll_connection (Data Source)

AdRoll Connection

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polytomic_adroll_connection" "adroll" {
  id = "aab123aa-27f3-abc1-9999-abcde123a4aa"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `organization` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Read-Only:

- `advertisers` (Attributes Set) AdRoll advertisers whose segments are available as sync destinations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration--advertisers))
- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method

    How Polytomic authenticates with AdRoll: oauth or token (a personal access token). Valid values: <code>oauth</code> (OAuth), <code>token</code> (Personal access token). Default: <code>oauth</code>.
